map.某公司净利润 400 万元、平均净资产 2000 万元，ROE=400/2000: A company has net income of 400 (10k CNY) and average equity of 2000 (10k CNY), so ROE = 400/2000 = 20% - every 1 yuan invested by shareholders returns 0.2 yuan a year.
map.ROE 高一定好吗？: Is a high ROE always good?
map.高 ROE 可能来自高盈利，也可能来自高杠杆（高风险）。应拆解其驱动来源，区分是: A high ROE may come from high profitability or from high leverage (high risk). Break down its drivers to tell whether the return is from excellent operations or piled-up debt.
map.ROE=EPS÷每股净资产，同等 ROE 下净资产越小 EPS 越高；但过度依赖: ROE = EPS ÷ book value per share; at the same ROE, a smaller equity base means a higher EPS; but relying too much on debt to lift ROE sacrifices financial safety.
map.净资产收益率（本页代码口径）：ROE=净利润÷净资产×100（%）；联动量：小数: Return on equity (actual code on this page): ROE = net profit ÷ net assets × 100 (%); linked values: decimal form = net profit ÷ max(net assets,10⁻⁹), equity multiple = net assets ÷ max(net profit,10⁻⁹), per-ten-thousand = net profit ÷ net assets × 10000. Validation: both fields are required and must be valid numbers, otherwise it prompts and stops. Rule: no fixed grading; ROE is proportional to net profit and inversely proportional to net assets.
map.净资产收益率（本页代码口径）：ROE=净利润÷平均净资产×100（%）；联动量：: Return on equity (this page's code definition): ROE = net profit ÷ average equity × 100 (%). Linked values: decimal form = net profit ÷ equity; equity ÷ net profit (x). Validation: net profit and equity are required finite numbers. When equity is 0, ROE and the reciprocal show "Not applicable"; when net profit is 0, the reciprocal shows "Not applicable". Math.max is no longer used to replace negative values with a tiny positive number. Rule: ROE is proportional to net profit and inversely proportional to average equity; negative equity must be read in the context of insolvency.
map.净资产为 0 时 ROE 不适用；负权益须结合资不抵债背景解读。: When equity is 0, ROE is not applicable; negative equity must be read in the context of insolvency.
map.净资产为 0 或为负时怎么显示？: How are zero or negative equity shown?
map.净资产为 0 时分母无定义，ROE 与净资产÷净利润都显示不适用；净资产为负时按: When equity is 0 the denominator is undefined, so ROE and equity ÷ net profit both show "Not applicable". With negative equity the true denominator is used, but the page warns that the sign cannot be read as a normal return.
